title: Agent Health (v2)
description: Response body for GET /health/ready. Used by orchestrators and the gateway for liveness/readiness.

configured.description: Whether the kernel has valid credentials configured.

session_store_ready.description: Whether the session store backend is reachable.

agent_state_ready.description: Whether the agent state store backend is reachable.

python_version.description: Informational tech-stack version (v0.23.4); never affects readiness.

fastapi_version.description: Informational tech-stack version (v0.23.4); never affects readiness.

agentscope_version.description: Informational tech-stack version (v0.23.4); null in non-agentscope modes.

session_store_version.description: Session store server version when available (e.g. PostgreSQL/Redis); informational only.

agent_state_version.description: Agent state store server version when available (e.g. PostgreSQL); informational only.
